name: 1.23.0-beta.42
notes: Modding mode is much smoother with big stories: only the boxes in view are drawn, the arrows are drawn on a canvas, and zoomed far out the boxes are drawn simply (tap one to zoom in on it). On a story with 700 scenes, moving around went from about 4 frames a second to a smooth 60.

Modding mode: a better layout. Scenes that lead to each other are grouped, long columns wrap instead of going on for hundreds of boxes, and scenes nothing leads to sit in a tidy grid below. A scene that many others lead to (a shared helper) no longer ties everything together, and its arrows only show while it, or a scene that leads to it, is selected.
Modding mode: move a box by dragging its title. Where you put it is remembered with the game. “Tidy” puts every box back in its place. Opening a box (“+ N more”) makes room for it.
